The **Yukkit Launcher** installs, updates and starts **Yukkit Toolkit** for Minecraft, with one button.

**Downloads**
- `Yukkit.Launcher_x.y.z_x64-setup.exe`: installer (recommended), adds a Start menu shortcut.
- `YukkitLauncher-portable.exe`: runs without installing.

**What's inside**
- Pick a game version next to the Play button. Today that's **Minecraft 26.3**, and new versions appear on their own.
- Java, Minecraft, Fabric, Fabric API and Yukkit Toolkit are installed for you, with clear progress.
- The newest Yukkit Toolkit build is installed when you press Play. Preview builds are optional.
- Patch notes and the latest news, read straight from Yukkit Toolkit's releases.
- Problems are explained in plain English, with a Try again button.
- Offline accounts. Each version keeps its own worlds and mods.

> ⚠️ **Some modules can get you banned** on servers that don't allow them. Yukkit Toolkit is made for anarchy servers.
>
> **Alpha build.** Back up worlds you care about.

The `.exe` isn't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn the first time: click **More info → Run anyway**.
